messages:
tara-sales: FYI FinEdge POC: traces not linking in Datadog, and occasional 429s on log forwarder. Need quick presales triage.

kevin-eng: Are they on Private with our drain? If so, check header passthrough. Common culprit: `preserve_headers: []`.

anya-se: Also watch for nonstandard key names in logs (e.g., TRACEID). Datadog expects `traceparent` or `x-datadog-trace-id`. Suggest adding a rename transform.

jira-ops-bot: PLAT-8011 created: TEMP_BURST_REQUEST for FinEdge POC (requested by tara-sales). ETA 1h.

kevin-eng: Quick fixes to ask customer: 1) update drain to preserve trace headers (traceparent,x-request-id,x-b3-traceid), 2) enable batching + backoff in forwarder, 3) add `/debug/headers` endpoint and paste output.

anya-se: For PII question in their security form: we provide transform templates to redact keys `email|ssn|card`. For Private POCs, redaction runs customer-side unless DPA signed. Provide the template snippet.

tara-sales: I'm sending instructions now and asking for `/debug/headers`. Will loop back when they redeploy. Thanks! :thumbsup:
